in_sanskrit.name: शिद्धार्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has acquired or obtained all the material possessions and spiritual knowledge.

in_marathi.name: Siddarth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achiever of Goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A person who has attained their goals or desires. The name Siddarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sidhartha' meaning 'perfect, accomplished, accomplished, achieved, or accomplished in one's goals'. It is also the name of the legendary prince who renounced his throne and embarked on a spiritual journey to find enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: Siddarth

The name Siddarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sidhartha' meaning 'perfect, accomplished, accomplished, achieved, or accomplished in one's goals'. It is also the name of the legendary prince who renounced his throne and embarked on a spiritual journey to find enlightenment.
